products.title: Dodge Snake Taupe
products.body_html:
The 'Dodge' boot reinterprets vintage western style with its elongated pointy shape in a mix of hand-sanded Black leather and Taupe imitation snake, offset by a rubber sole with grippy tractor tread. It features pull-tabs for easy entry, partial leather lining and a comfortable memory foam insole.

As this style has a narrow shape, we recommend sizing up if you are in-between sizes.

This style might feel narrow because of its reinforced pointy toe shape. We suggest sizing up if you prefer a roomier fit.

products.title: Stereo Macchiato Canvas
products.body_html:
Stereo Macchiato in Kakishibu-dyed canvas, a traditional Japanese dye made from fermented unripe persimmons. It naturally strengthens the canvas and provides water resistance, while the colour continues to deepen and develop a unique patina with wear and exposure.

Stereo features a flexible vulcanised rubber sole with a unique certified anti-slip outsole for superior grip. An insole with arch support and exceptional cushioning provides comfort, while strong nylon laces and vent eyelets add functionality. A black rubber stripe accentuates the wrapped sidewall’s contour, while the toe cap adds protection.

products.title: Insole
products.body_html:
Free insole with full-priced styles. Limited time only. 

Crafted for those who are in-between sizes, this insole provides subtle cushioning, improves fit, and naturally molds to your foot for all-day comfort. Placed underneath the existing insole, it makes the shoe fit about half an EU size smaller. Best worn with our sneakers.
